ops.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience upon 30 days' prior written notice to Vendor, in which case Vendor shall refund any prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience during a committed term.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The three-year term gives us no way out without cause, so we have inserted a new Section 9.4 allowing Customer to terminate for convenience on 30 days' written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, and confirming Vendor has no convenience right during a committed term. That is our standard termination-for-convenience position; we are happy to discuss 60 days' notice with an early-termination fee capped at three months' Fees instead.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 9.4: Customer termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with refund of prepaid Fees; no Vendor convenience right during a committed term

mappings.element: No more than 30 days' written notice.
No Vendor termination-for-convenience right during a committed term.
